title: NeoRPG
description: An adventure, combat, and puzzle mod pack lets you explore a world full of things and gather resources to become the best.
body:
NeoRPG Description:

A modpack where you'll fight bosses and explore a giant world filled with spells, hostile enemies, and much more, including quests that will reward you and much more.

There are also new foods and improved giant structures of all kinds.

Go ahead and download this modpack to enjoy an RPG world full of content.

This is one of my first modpacks; it's not fully optimized or the best in the world, but I'm learning how to make quality modpacks. I'm just starting out, but this modpack will receive updates that will improve many things and add more content and quests.

Modpack inspired by KeoRPG
